feed.title: PrintReady AI: scorecard updates
feed.subtitle: Weekly print-readiness scores for AI text/image-to-3D generators. Raw output, locked prompts, OrcaSlicer + trimesh.

entry.title: Correction: the Hunyuan3D-2.1 "ground plate" was our input artifact (re-tested)
entry.summary: Earlier we reported a built-in plate on 4 of 6 Hunyuan3D-2.1 meshes. Re-tested with the same seed and settings but with the background removed locally first (RGBA input): the plate is gone on all 4. It came from the Space's background removal on our off-white references. Re-test scores: T01 86.6, T04 98.2, T05 72.2, T06 95.6. Meshes, JSON and matted refs are published.

entry.title: First cross-vendor score: Meshy 6 Lite (free plan) on the same 6 prompts
entry.summary: Meshy 6 Lite (Meshy free plan, untextured image-to-3D, 60 free credits, $0 — not flagship Meshy 7.1) scored on rubric v0.2: T01 99.5, T02 80.5, T03 80.0, T04 81.2, T05 39.0, T06 86.9. 6 of 6 watertight; T05 slice hard-fail (Orca exit 156). Mean ~77.9 trails Hunyuan3D-2 (~82.3) and Hunyuan3D-2.1 (~83.2); T01 nearly matches Hunyuan3D-2. Three-generator render grid on the scorecard. Tripo, Hitem3D, Rodin, TRELLIS and Meshy 7.1 are queued.

entry.title: Second generator scored: Hunyuan3D-2.1 on the same 6 prompts (6 of 6 watertight)
entry.summary: Hunyuan3D-2.1 (tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.1 public Space, rubric v0.2): T01 81.7, T02 83.2, T03 96.7, T04 81.6, T05 73.8, T06 82.3. All 6 watertight, no hard fails, A thin plate seen on T01, T04, T05 and T06 was later found to be an input artifact (see correction). Shaded side-by-side renders vs Hunyuan3D-2 on the scorecard. Both are open-source Tencent models; Meshy, Tripo, Hitem3D, Rodin and TRELLIS are queued.

entry.title: Rubric v0.2: real tree supports, hollow skin, bed contact; all 6 Hunyuan3D-2 prompts re-scored
entry.summary: Slice success cut from 20 to 5 points; support volume now from a real OrcaSlicer tree-support slice; print time not scored; new hull fill and bed contact checks, scored in the glTF Y-up pose. New scores (v0.1 kept as history): T01 98.2, T02 86.9, T03 89.8, T04 100, T05 26.9, T06 91.7.

entry.title: What it costs to get a printable AI 3D model (prices checked 2026-10-31)
entry.summary: Plan prices, free-tier limits, vendor-stated cost per model and commercial-use terms, copied from each vendor's pricing page. Only Hunyuan3D-2 is scored so far; the paid tools are queued.

entry.title: Rubric v2 diagnostics: hull fill, wall thickness, bed contact (and an orientation issue we found)
entry.summary: Measured hollow-skin, wall-thickness and first-layer checks on the 6 Hunyuan3D-2 meshes. v0.1 sliced with Z-up while glTF is Y-up; v0.2 will cut slice weight to 5 and re-score in Y-up.

entry.title: Open data: CSV/JSON scores and raw Hunyuan3D-2 meshes (CC BY 4.0)
entry.summary: Every score is downloadable as CSV/JSON, with the gzipped raw meshes, reference images and SHA256SUMS so anyone can re-check the numbers.
